title: 第007章 众人皆道少女弱，一招封敌惊满堂
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

清晨的第一缕晨光穿透山间薄雾，洒在清风宗外门的院落之间。

微凉的山风卷着翠竹清香，掠过青石板路，驱散了深夜残留的沉寂，整座宗门渐渐苏醒过来。

蔡文姬简单洗漱完毕，推开房门来到了院子里，伸了个软乎乎的懒腰，周身萦绕着淡淡的音律灵气。

经过一夜奔波与灵气运转，她体内的力量愈发凝练，灵魂深处绑定的三大技能也随之悄然精进了几分。

【思无邪】的治愈范围更广，修复暗伤的效果更强，【胡笳乐】的眩晕时长与弹射距离也有了小幅提升。

唯独大招【忘忧曲】依旧处于封印状态，需要积攒足够功德、突破当前境界，才能彻底解锁施展。

忘忧曲对应上古胡笳本命大招，仙骨未圆满，故而本源力量被牢牢封锁。

对此蔡文姬并不心急，一步一个脚印慢慢来，才是最稳妥的修仙方式。

她本打算像前两日一样，守在院落之中，等候同门前来调理伤势，顺便借着与人接触的机会，继续打探宗门内部的大小消息。

可院门刚了过来。

“就是这里了！昨晚收拾我们的那个丫头，就住在这个院子里！”

“敢管老子们的闲事，还收缴我们的财物，真是活腻歪了！一个靠着旁门左道混进宗门的新人，也敢在太岁头上动土？”

“今天非得好好教训她一顿，让她知道外门到底是谁说了算！”

叫嚷声粗野蛮横，带着毫不掩饰的戾气，引得沿途不少早起的外门弟子纷纷探头张望。

众人循声望去，只见五名身着外门服饰的男弟子簇拥在一起，气势汹汹地堵在了蔡文姬的院门外。

为首一人身形高大，面容粗犷，眉眼间满是凶横，腰间挎着一柄劣质铁剑。

正是昨日深夜下山作恶、被蔡文姬用音波定身惩戒的领头人，赵虎。

赵虎在清风宗外门混迹已有五年，修为卡在炼气四层，在外门一众普通弟子里算是小有实力。

平日里他拉帮结派，拉拢了四五个臭味相投的同门，抱团欺压新晋弟子。

抢夺旁人的修炼丹药、灵石与宗门分发的粗粮，在外门早已是人人敢怒不敢言的存在。

昨夜一行人深夜下山搜刮百姓，本以为神不知鬼不觉。

结果半路被突然出现的蔡文姬一招制服，钱财被尽数收走，身上戾气也被音波净化！

回到宗门之后更是浑身酸软，提不起半点力气。

几人憋了一肚子火气，辗转打听了整整一夜，终于查到了蔡文姬的住处，天刚亮就结伴前来寻仇。

巷道两侧的弟子见状，纷纷压低声音议论起来，脸上写满了担忧。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The first ray of morning light penetrates the mist in the mountains and shines in the courtyard of the Qingfeng Sect's outer gate.

The cool mountain breeze carries the fragrance of green bamboo and passes over the bluestone road, dispelling the remaining silence of the night, and the entire sect gradually wakes up.

After Cai Wenji simply washed up, she opened the door and came to the yard. She stretched out her soft body, and there was a faint aura of music lingering around her body.

After a night of running around and running her spiritual energy, the power in her body became more and more concentrated, and the three major skills bound deep in her soul also quietly improved.

[Si Wuxie] has a wider healing range and is more effective at repairing hidden damage. The stun duration and ejection distance of [Hu Jile] have also been slightly increased.

Only the ultimate move [Song of Forgetfulness] is still in a sealed state. It needs to accumulate enough merit and break through the current state to be completely unlocked and used.

Wangyouqu corresponds to the ancient Hujia's ultimate move. The immortal bone has not been perfected, so the original power is firmly blocked.

Cai Wenji is not impatient about this. Taking her time step by step is the safest way to cultivate immortality.

She originally planned to stay in the courtyard like the previous two days, waiting for her fellow sect members to come to tend to her injuries, and by the way, she would continue to inquire about the news within the sect by taking advantage of the opportunity of contacting people.

But the courtyard gate just came over.

"This is it! The girl who took care of us last night lives in this courtyard!"

"How dare you meddle in my business and confiscate our belongings? How disgusting! A newcomer who sneaked into the sect by relying on side sects dares to make trouble on Tai Sui's head?"

"I have to teach her a lesson today to let her know who has the final say in the outer sect!"

The shouting was rude and brutal, with undisguised hostility, causing many early-rising outer sect disciples along the way to look around.

Everyone looked around and saw five male disciples dressed in outer attire gathered together and blocking the door of Cai Wenji's courtyard in a menacing manner.

The leader was tall, with a rough face, and a fierce look on his face. He had a low-quality iron sword slung around his waist.

It was Zhao Hu, the leader who went down the mountain late last night to commit evil and was punished by Cai Wenji with sound waves.

Zhao Hu has been in the outer sect of Qingfeng Sect for five years. His cultivation is stuck at the fourth level of Qi Refining, and he is considered to be a little powerful among the ordinary disciples of the outer sect.

On weekdays, he formed a clique and recruited four or five like-minded fellow disciples to bully the new disciples.

Stealing other people's cultivation elixirs, spiritual stones, and coarse grains distributed by the sect has long been something that everyone in the outer sect dares not say anything about.

Last night, a group of people went down the mountain late at night to search for people. They thought they were unaware of the situation.

As a result, he was subdued by Cai Wenji who suddenly appeared halfway, all his money was taken away, and the violent energy in his body was purified by sound waves!

After returning to the sect, his whole body was sore and weak, and he couldn't muster any strength.

Several people held back their anger and spent the whole night asking around. Finally, they found out where Cai Wenji lived. They came together at dawn to seek revenge.

Seeing this, the disciples on both sides of the alleyway began to discuss in lowered voices, with worry written all over their faces.

title_en: Chapter 007: Everyone thinks that young girls are weak, and the enemy is defeated with one move and the whole room is shocked.
